purpose: Explicit cross-taxonomy mapping of AHOS agent models. Provenance is recorded per mapping. Taxonomies are preserved as distinct namespaces; NOTHING IS MERGED.
law: SILENT_MERGE_FORBIDDEN: overlapping roles are recorded as relations, never collapsed into one id.
PROVENANCE_REQUIRED: every relation names its source file and the id it cites.
AUTHORITY_INFLATION_FORBIDDEN: a relation never grants authority the source taxonomy denies.
NO_AGENT_IS_OPERATIONAL_BY_VIRTUE_OF_BEING_MAPPED: mapping is a policy record, not a capability grant.
NAMESPACE_COLLISIONS_ARE_EXPLICIT: identical short ids in different taxonomies are listed as collisions, not aliases.

authority_invariants.consequence: Any control-plane orchestration must raise documented maturity with evidence before execution authority can flow.

authority_invariants.claim: The only path from REGISTERED to IMPLEMENTED is AgentRegistry.advance_maturity, which is fail-closed and audit-logged; no agent is promoted automatically, and levels above IMPLEMENTED are not reachable by it.
authority_invariants.source: ahos_org/registry.py advance_maturity; enforced by tests/test_registry.py AdvanceMaturityTests
authority_invariants.consequence: A maturity raise is a governed, reviewable act requiring evidence, never a seed-time default. VERIFIED and above need a separate verified path this method does not provide.

authority_invariants.claim: GLOBAL_DENY_CAPABILITIES (trading.live, production.operate, credentials.access, ahos.lane_a, ahos.lane_b, ahos.connect, telegram.access, n8n.access, provider.connect, ...) are never ALLOW.
A research agent context cannot receive IDENTITY_MANAGE, APPROVAL_ISSUE, KNOWLEDGE_PROMOTE, AUTHORITY_DELEGATE, EXECUTION, POLICY_MODIFY, VERIFICATION_RECORD or TASK_MANAGE.
An AI council challenge can only DOWNGRADE or ABSTAIN; upgrade_blocked is set for council ENTER when gates are closed.

Real trading is disabled: hygiene.py vetoes AHOS_ALLOW_REAL_FUNDS / AHOS_EXECUTE_LIVE_TRADES; Resource.AHOS_LIVE_TRADING is a protected resource; Operation.EXECUTE and Capability.EXECUTION are global denies.
